name: economic_attack_vectors
description: ERC-4626-style vault share/price accounting vulnerable to donation-based inflation attack
question: The source file in `source` implements share-based vault or pool accounting (a deposit/mint function that computes shares from total assets, or an exchange-rate/share-price function), and it computes total assets or the exchange rate directly from the token's balanceOf(address(this)) without virtual shares/assets, a minimum initial deposit check, or dead-share minting, allowing an attacker to donate tokens directly to the contract to inflate the share price and cause a subsequent depositor's shares to round down to zero, letting the attacker redeem and steal the victim's deposited assets.
criteria: totalAssets() or getExchangeRate() returns IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this)) divided by totalSupply/totalShares with no offset
shares minted on deposit computed as assets * totalSupply / totalAssets with no virtual share/asset constants added
no check preventing or limiting the first deposit (e.g. no MIN_INITIAL_DEPOSIT revert when totalSupply()==0)
no dead-share minting or permanent minimum share lock on first deposit
no internal tracked variable (e.g. totalManagedAssets) used instead of balanceOf for accounting
